label: rem:torus-chain-pages-on-bring
title: The pages of the torus-knot components embed on Bring's surface, and their complements carry the Bring frame
html:
Every knotted component of the canonical closure is a (2, 2g+1)-torus knot with g \in \{1, 2, 3\}, and a torus knot is fibered: its complement is an open book whose pages are Seifert surfaces of genus g sharing the knot as binding, with monodromy of order 2(2g+1) and a unimodular Seifert form, so H_1(\text{page}) is self-dual -- a frame with a dual frame. Since the cohomological embedding criterion that fixes the genus of Bring's surface is \operatorname{rank} H_1(\mathrm{Seifert}(T_{2,s})) = (s-1)/2 \le g at the forced g = 4, the pages of T(2,3), T(2,5) and T(2,7) all embed on Bring's surface, and T(2,9) is the last of the family that does (pages_embed_on_bring, machine-checked).

The complement of T(2, 2g+1) is the unit tangent bundle of the (2, 2g+1, \infty) triangle orbifold, \mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{R})/\Delta(2, 2g+1, \infty); the link of the Bring cone is, canonically, the unit tangent bundle of Bring's curve, \mathrm{PSL}(2,\mathbb{R})/\Gamma_4 (Bézout gives the canonical embedding degree 6 = 2g - 2). Both therefore carry the global left-invariant frame \{X, Y, V\} -- geodesic, horocyclic, fibre rotation -- and two Reeb flows: V, whose orbits are the Seifert circles transverse to the pages, and X, whose closed orbits are closed geodesics of the base. This is the concrete form of the coordinate frame the osculating-circle pencil of a plane curve suggests and cannot itself supply, since that pencil lives on a curve and the closure is an isotopy class.

Two limits. The frame is the split real form \mathfrak{sl}_2(\mathbb{R}), whereas the Reeb triad modelled on the Bring cone link elsewhere in this manuscript is the compact form \mathfrak{su}(2); a genus-4 unit tangent bundle has \widetilde{\mathrm{SL}_2} geometry and admits no 3-Sasakian structure, so which real form is intended there is a question for that lemma (docs/audits/2026-09-03-bring-cone-link-is-the-unit-tangent-bundle.md). And none of this reaches the twist: the framing datum the binding gap needs is the torsion integral, which neither the pages nor the circle pencil carry by themselves.
